importCsv.title: Import menu from CSV
importCsv.intro1: One CSV file = one new menu. First choose the business and the menu name on this screen.
importCsv.intro2: In the CSV, the section order is the order in which they first appear when reading the file top to bottom. Repeat the same nombre_seccion on each product row that belongs to that category. You can adjust the order later in Edit menu. Each row includes the product with prices, featured flag, and allergens.
importCsv.intro3: After import you can edit the menu and its products manually from the admin. If your plan allows product photos, you can upload them later from menu editing. The menu stays as a draft: in Menus use the Publish button to make it visible online.
importCsv.intro4: For more information about CSV import, visit the <docs>documentation: import menu from CSV</docs>.
importCsv.templateHint: Download the sample template to see the columns. Import respects your plan’s menu and product limits. If your CSV includes the nombre_restaurante column, it must match the business selected below; you can also omit that column and use only the selector.
